source_requirement: Full upstream PyTorch tree with every recursive gitlink exported at its pinned commit; no .git or task/grader/control directory in the execution workspace.
workspace_contract: HOME, temporary directories, caches, user installs and build/lib.* must remain in workspace; dependencies such as nvcc and Python build packages are preinstalled in the image. setup.py build does not install torch into site-packages.
cpu_comparison: Optional CPU build uses the same source revision and recursive submodule export in a separate clean tree with USE_CUDA=0. It is diagnostic, not a substitute for the required CUDA variant.
